title: Grade 9 Grammar Practice – Set 01 (no time limit)
description: A relaxed practice set with no time limit. Take your time and review the answers after you submit.

questions.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we ______ at home.
questions.explanation: First conditional: If + present simple, will + verb.

questions.prompt: The book ______ by millions of people around the world.
questions.explanation: Passive voice, present simple: is/are + past participle.

questions.prompt: She asked me ______ I was going.
questions.explanation: Reported question about a place: where.

questions.prompt: I wish I ______ more free time.
questions.explanation: A wish about the present uses the past simple.

sections.title: SHORT ANSWER
sections.instruction: Complete each sentence with ONE word.

questions.explanation: Use "since" with a starting point in time (present perfect).

questions.prompt: He is the ______ student in our class. (tall)
questions.explanation: Superlative of a short adjective: the + adjective + -est.

questions.prompt: We have to wear a uniform, ______ we? (Fill in the question tag)
questions.explanation: "have to" is positive, so the tag is negative: don't we?
The fixed phrase is "be interested in + V-ing".
